text_block_list.text:
Everyone went wild. Over the reunion of 
the two on the turf.

The continuation of an interrupted story. 
The victor of its first battle is—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much. Thank you, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: And above all... Neo-san!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I believe this victory only shines bright 
because of you!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy, a "celebration." And—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "calibration" will not falter. Even in 
this universe.

As expected of the one who achieved the 
Autumn Senior Triple Crown in another 
universe. Zenno Rob Roy's power showed no 
sign of fading.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, in this race, Neo Universe was 
able to confirm the "orbit".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
We can keep going, can't we... forever, 
just like this.

There is no need to worry anymore. I have 
completely broken free from that other 
universe's misfortune. However...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Negative? At this rate... I can't go?
choice_data_list: Yeah, because there are so many "RÊVES."
Yeah, because there are so many "RÊVE"s.

text_block_list.text:
The path of stars stretches straight 
ahead. Yet, it does not simply continue.

There are new encounters, and even 
stronger bonds with the Umamusume met 
along the way.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, Liebe Liebe, it's Liebe, isn't 
it~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really get to join in much today, 
but next time~.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――? Trainer, Zenno Rob Roy has become... 
an "alien lifeform".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle! Universe-chan, I'm Hishi 
Miracle~! Not an alien species!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Great work out there, Hishi Miracle-san. 
Thank you very much for today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, Robroy-chan, you noticed I was in it? 
Well, that makes it a little better, 
then~.

Not since last year's Takarazuka Kinen. 
The child of miracles, Hishi Miracle, was 
also participating in this race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two. Since we're all in the 
Senior Class together now and got closer 
like this~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I guess I just wanted to talk a bit more. 
Like, uh... I was hoping we could be 
friends~ or something.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected, that might be a little 
annoying, huh~? Still, what if...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle... That's "FELT"... isn't 
it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe wishes to seek "expansion." 
With you too. And……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to "rival" them. The "Great King" 
and the "Singularity."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Di... did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um~, is it like you wanna beat Dai-chan or 
Tokui-chan?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Affirmative.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah... That's... kind of creepy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Universe-chan seems pretty intense, but 
maybe she could have a little more fun 
with it~ Or so I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, n-no, nothing! But, you know!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Let's all make it interesting! Um, the 
next race is~

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Next...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —The Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup... is next!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Then the Japan Cup. Me too!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

There is no hesitation. Tokyo, 2400m on 
turf. The second leg of the Senior Autumn 
Triple Crown.

My friends are here, my seniors are here, 
and people all over the world are 
watching. This will truly be the 
culmination of the reborn Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The stars... gather. The stars of "MAZN." 
Neo Universe is no longer "STDA."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If we form a star cluster, we can 
"compete." Against the "King" and the 
"Singularity." But...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Have a little more fun"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe came to "fight together." And 
yet……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I sense... a fluctuation... If there is a 
correction... I want to know.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: At the Japan Cup, Neo Universe...
